input.prompt:
ORIGINAL premium mobile 2D tower-defense map concept. Keep the SAME broad one-screen composition family as MAP-A: landscape 16:9, one readable winding route from left spawn to right exit/base, the entire battlefield visible without camera scrolling, strong casual-game readability, playful stylized shapes, saturated colors, friendly cartoon rendering, soft outlines, large readable silhouettes, whimsical environmental storytelling. Do NOT copy any existing Plants vs Zombies map, characters, UI, textures, props, or composition. Do NOT make it look like Kingdom Rush. No text, no UI, no technical grid. Planting locations should be clearly readable circular/natural pads, but final exact coordinates belong to Unity.

THEME: ANCIENT SUN-AND-MOON TEMPLE. Target exactly 12 visible planting spots. Mossy courtyards, ceremonial pools, broken colonnades, flowers, carved ritual platforms, friendly guardian statues and sun/moon mechanisms. Dynamic mechanic: rotating temple mirrors/sun-disks sweep beams and periodically open or close small side alcoves/route interactions. Secrets: guardian miniboss altar, hidden sanctum that unlocks a special support tower, secret relic chamber for an upgrade. Luxurious but playful, never gritty.
